figurative_meaning_en: For a specific period of time
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পটি টাইম-বাঁধা, তাই দেরি করা যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This project is time-bound, so we can't delay it.
note: This is a modern hybrid idiom incorporating English 'time' with Bengali 'বাঁধা', reflecting contemporary urban influences in Bengali language.
